about: Folk dance tunes labelled by hand. Only labels, no audio: point score_folk.py at a local copy. dance, meter and grouping come from the person who knows the tunes; bar_sec was measured from the onset autocorrelation (the strongest period matching the labelled meter) and is approximate (about 1 %). grouping lists the beats of one bar in units of 'unit'; it is compared as positions within the bar, so neither the unit nor the bar start matters.

tunes.notes: accelerando, bar 1.46 s at the start to 1.35 s near the end
